title: (fix) O3-5986: Show a visit note's saved images when editing it
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

An image uploaded through a visit note saves and shows up on the Attachments page, but it's missing when we reopen the note to edit it. The form only ever sent the patient when uploading, so the obs ended up encounterless, and the edit form never looked for saved images anyway.

Images added to a note now go up with the note's encounter UUID, so the attachment obs lands on that encounter. When we edit the note, the form loads the attachments recorded on that encounter and shows them ahead of any new uploads. Only images added in this session live in the form state, so editing just the text uploads nothing and adding another image uploads only that one. The create form makes no attachments request since there's no encounter to look up yet.

Saved images are read only in the form. We don't offer a remove control for them on purpose: `DELETE /attachment/{uuid}` purges the obs and then voids the encounter when no obs are left ([AttachmentResource.voidEncounterIfEmpty](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-module-attachments/blob/master/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/attachments/rest/AttachmentResource.java)), which would take a note with blank text and its diagnoses down with it. Removing a saved image needs to void the obs instead; that's O3-5990.

Older notes whose images were saved without an encounter keep showing on the Attachments page. We don't guess them onto a note.

Because the images now sit on the note's encounter, they also show up in the encounter expansion on the Visits page, where a complex obs used to render as `ATT IMAGE ATTACHMENT: m3ks` (the REST display string is the attachments module's storage marker). The observations list now shows a complex obs as its caption, or the file name parsed from `valueComplex`, as a link. Clicking it opens a new read-only `attachment-preview-modal` from the attachments app (file name, caption, image or PDF); the href still points at the bytes endpoint so the file can be opened in a new tab. The Attachments page keeps its full-screen preview with the delete action, and the image/PDF rendering the two share now lives in one `AttachmentMedia` component. The visit and encounter representations fetch `valueComplex` and `comment` for that. The attachment bytes URL was hand-built in three apps; it's now `getAttachmentBytesUrl` in esm-patient-common-lib.

Depends on openmrs/openmrs-esm-core#1887 for the new `createAttachment` and `useAttachments` parameters. That has merged and main already resolves `@openmrs/esm-framework` to the `next` build that carries it (10.0.1-pre.5452), so this PR needs no lockfile change.

Verified end to end against a local backend with that framework build: the obs sits on the note encounter, the saved image shows on reopen, a text-only edit doesn't re-upload, a second image adds without duplicating, and the Attachments page still lists everything. Exercised JPEG and PNG through the picker, a webcam capture, and a PDF on the same encounter (hidden from the note's Image section, still on the Attachments page).

While testing this I found three pre-existing problems in the upload flow that are out of scope here: https://issues.openmrs.org/browse/O3-5987 (the dialog ignores the caller's allowed extensions and reports "Upload complete" early), https://issues.openmrs.org/browse/O3-5988 (the size limit shown isn't the backend's), and https://issues.openmrs.org/browse/O3-5989 (a rejected
